newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta shares close lower on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta shares close lower on profit-taking.

text.p: Jakarta share prices closed sharply lower on Wednesday due to local-led profit-taking in late trading, brokers said.
The Jakarta Composite Index fell 2.39 points, or 0.44 percent, to 541.77 points after touching a low of 540.98 points. Losers led gainers by 59 to 33, with 58 counters unchanged.
Brokers said after making significant gains on Tuesday, many players took profit on selected counters as market sentiment remaina volatile.
"With weak sentiment and no support from regional markets, many players were adopting short-term plays," one broker said.

Property and hotel firm Mas Murni Indonesia topped the active list, rising 125 rupiah to 825 on a volume of 11.3 million shares. Brokers said the rise was due to talk of a possible acquisition and a tender offer despite a company denial.

Transportation firm Steady Safe fell 200 rupiah to 2,100 rupiah after rising to 2,475 rupiah in early trade, on a volume of 6.6 million shares. Brokers said the moves were due to profit-taking after the early gains.
Oil and natural gas firm PT Medco Energi rose 25 rupiah to 2,750 on a volume of 9.9 million shares, off a high of 2,925 rupiah in early trade.

The company said on Tuesday that it was likely to exceed its 1996 and 1997 net income target after the discovery of additional oil and natural gas resources in South Sumatra coupled with a rise in international oil prices.
Heavyweight cigarette maker Sampoerna also fell on profit-taking. It fell 75 rupiah to 22,125 rupiah on a turnover of 154,000 shares. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
